{{Quote|Two days ago the Imperials launched a multiple attack on targets in the Abrion and Dufilvian sectors. They severely damaged the military base at Ord Pardron and captured the Ukio system.|[[Talon Karrde]] to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Abrion sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was an example of a sector that had swelled well over the original 50 system allocation for sectors,<ref name="ISB">[[Imperial Sourcebook (Second Edition)|''Imperial Sourcebook'', Second Edition]]</ref> containing over 200 [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworlds]].<ref name="hhn" /> [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in Abrion included [[Galpos II/Legends|Galpos II]], [[Garban]], [[Hefi]], [[Hishyim]], [[Intuci]], [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]],<ref name="SWR" /> [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]],<ref name="TLCSb" /> and the sector capital, [[Abrion Major/Legends|Abrion Major]].<ref name="hhn" />

==History==
During the final years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the sector was represented in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] by [[Esu Rotsino/Legends|Esu Rotsino]]. However, during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the sector seceded to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], based on economic reasons relating to the export of its foodstuffs.<ref name="hhn" />

During the [[Thrawn campaign|Thrawn Crisis]], the capture of the sector, including [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]], was a serious loss to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], who relied on the system as one of its top five producers.<ref name="TLC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Da Soocha]], [[Cathar (location)/Legends|Cathar]], and [[Abregado-rae/Legends|Abregado-rae]] in the Abrion sector. Da Soocha is in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]; Cathar is in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]]; and Abregado-rae is in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="EAOC" />
